text:
maya: Hi — quick Q. I have temporary guardianship of my sister's 9yo niece for the school year (court order dated 2026-03-10). We missed open enroll. Can I add her to my benefits as a dependent? She just moved here and doesn't have an SSN yet.

jen (Benefits): Congrats on helping your family. Temporary guardianship can qualify as a QLE if the court order grants custody/guardianship. We'll need the court order, proof of residence (school or utility mail), and the child's passport or birth certificate. SSN/ITIN can be added later — carriers usually allow provisional enrollment pending SSN.

otto (People Ops): Steps: 1) In HiBob choose Benefits > Add Dependent, 2) attach the court order + residence proof + ID, 3) select change reason "Qualified Life Event - guardianship" and set event date to 2026-03-10. If you prefer, email benefits@redwood.com with the docs and we'll create the request.

maya: What's acceptable for proof of residence if the child just arrived? School enrollment letter okay?

jen (Benefits): Yes a school enrollment letter or school district residency form is fine. If none, a notarized statement plus short-term lease or utility bill in your name showing the child's address will work. For foreign docs, include certified translation.

maya: About SSN — it might take several weeks. Will coverage start immediately?

jen (Benefits): We can provisionally enroll with the documents above; coverage effective date will be the guardianship date once approved. Mark the record pending-SSN and provide SSN/ITIN when available within 60 days. Carrier follow-up possible.

otto (People Ops): Payroll note: retro premiums may apply back to the guardianship date if Benefits approves. Payroll cycles are 1-15 and 16-end. If you want to avoid a one-time lump sum, request to split the retro deduction across up to 2 paychecks when you submit. Tag @devin in the HiBob notes.

devin (Payroll): Yep — I'll monitor once Benefits finalizes. If docs are in before the 15th cutoff we can include retro in next pay; otherwise it'll land the following cycle. We can usually split over 2 pays on request.

people-ops-bot: Automated: Enrollment change submitted by maya — status: pending review. Ref: ENR-20260310-6610

maya: Submitted the HiBob request with court order + school letter and asked to split retro. Thanks all!

jen (Benefits): Received. We'll review and update this thread in 1-2 business days. Ping if no update.
